_comment: The LLM provider chain. Johnny tries each provider in `order` until one answers.
A provider is SKIPPED silently when its apiKeyEnv is not set, so an unconfigured
fallback costs nothing and breaks nothing. Every value here is tunable without
touching lib/llm.js — that is the point of this file.
Why this exists: on 2026-08-16 Groq retired llama-3.3-70b-versatile to enterprise-only
and Johnny went silent. Model IDs are not stable. They live in config now.

groq.label: Groq
_notes: reasoning_effort MUST stay 'low'. At the default ('medium') gpt-oss reasons itself
into refusing /roast — verified 2026-09-07: it replied 'I'm not going to do that.'
At 'low' it roasts in character in ~300ms.
Do NOT add reasoning_format here. gpt-oss does not support it and does not error —
it returns an EMPTY message and Johnny says nothing. Verified 2026-09-07.
include_reasoning:false keeps the model's scratchpad out of the response entirely.
reasoningHeadroom exists because reasoning_tokens are billed from the SAME budget
as the reply. Commands ask for as little as 40 tokens (/define, /convert, /wiki),
which a reasoning model can spend entirely on thinking — verified 2026-09-07: one
/define call returned an empty message, and /wiki replies truncated mid-word. The
headroom is added to whatever the caller asks for, so call sites keep sizing the
REPLY and the thinking room is set once, here. Set it to 0 for a non-reasoning model.
Free tier ceiling (verified against the live key 2026-09-07): 30 RPM, 1000 req/day,
8000 tokens/min, 200,000 tokens/day. The persona is ~900 input tokens, so the real
ceiling is roughly 190 replies/day. TPD is what runs out first, not requests.
Alternatives on this key if gpt-oss ever goes: openai/gpt-oss-20b (faster, thinner
writing), groq/compound-mini (best voice, but +1200 input tokens per call and only
250 req/day). Do NOT use qwen3.6-27b — it writes its chain-of-thought into the reply.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare Workers AI
_notes: DORMANT until CF_ACCOUNT_ID and CF_API_TOKEN are set. Skipped silently otherwise.
STRUCTURALLY VERIFIED, NOT LIVE-TESTED — there is no Cloudflare account to test
against yet. The base URL and OpenAI-compatible shape come from Cloudflare's docs;
the model ID is from their catalogue and should be confirmed on first use.
Why this one is the fallback: 10,000 neurons/day free, permanently, no credit card.
That is roughly 1,600 Johnny replies/day — far more headroom than Groq's free tier.
Cheaper per call if neurons ever get tight: @cf/meta/llama-3.2-3b-instruct.
